criterio: The 30 countries with the highest tax burden in the world, a group defined by the IBPT's IRBES study (14th edition, May 2025, 2023 data). Brazil is in the group on its own merit, in 30th place.
irbes.fonte: IBPT — study on tax burden/GDP vs. HDI, IRBES calculation, 14th edition
irbes.metodologia: IRBES weights the tax burden at 15% and HDI at 85%. The burden comes from the OECD; the HDI, from the UNDP.
irbes.fonteCargaPorPais.BRA: The study names the OECD as the source of the tax burden, but Brazil's figure (33.43%) is the result of the calculation the IBPT itself shows in section 2.1 (R$ 3.629 trillion collected over R$ 10.856 trillion of GDP). It is the only one of the 30 with two decimal places; the other 29 have one, in the format of the OECD tables.
